# JomForm — Full Context for AI Agents

> Order-form builder for Malaysian social sellers — free hosted service. Build
> beautiful order forms, accept payments through CHIP (FPX, cards, e-wallets,
> DuitNow QR), and manage sales — all without a website. Control everything
> from your own AI agent via the built-in MCP server, or use the web dashboard.

This is the full version of `llms.txt` for agents that want more detail. The
concise version is at [llms.txt](https://jomform.com/llms.txt).

## 1. What JomForm is

JomForm is a hosted order-form and payments platform for Malaysian social
sellers. Merchants build a drag-and-drop order form in about five minutes,
share a link, and buyers pay online the moment they submit. Sales status
updates itself and receipts are sent automatically. It is AI-agent native:
merchants can connect their own AI agent (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) over the Model
Context Protocol (MCP) and run the whole store through tools — products,
prices, sales, refunds, analytics — without opening a dashboard.

### Core capabilities

- **Order forms in minutes** — drag-and-drop products, fields, images, coupons. No code.
- **Payments** — secure checkout by CHIP: cards, FPX, DuitNow QR, e-wallets. One-time and subscription/recurring via CHIP card tokenization.
- **Auto-updated sales** — sales status updates itself, receipts sent automatically.
- **Analytics** — sales analytics, CSV export, PDF receipts. Free forever, no monthly fee.
- **AI-agent native** — MCP server built in; merchants connect their own AI agent and run the whole store through tools.

### Tech stack

- Go 1.26 backend (REST + MCP server + worker)
- PostgreSQL 18
- Valkey 9 (cache/queue)
- MinIO / S3-compatible object storage (Cloudflare R2 supported)
- Next.js 16 dashboard + form builder

## 3. MCP server (for AI agents)

JomForm exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI agents can connect
and operate a merchant's store programmatically.

### Connection details

- **Server URL:** `https://mcp.jomform.com/mcp` (the `/mcp` path is required).
- **Transport:** HTTP with dynamic client registration via OAuth 2.1 (PKCE).
  The server advertises at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.
- **Auth:** one-click OAuth 2.1 — no API keys or tokens to rotate. The agent
  authorizes against the merchant's JomForm account.

### Claude Desktop config example

Claude Desktop reads its MCP servers from `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "jomform": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.jomform.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Connection flow

1. Add the server URL to your MCP client config.
2. The client fetches the server and shows a JomForm login/authorize page.
3. Log in and grant access. The agent is now connected and can act on the store.
4. No API keys, no tokens to rotate — just start talking.

### Example commands once connected

- "add product RM25"
- "how many sales today?"
- "refund order JF-xxxx"
- "show my product inventory"

### Available MCP tools

The MCP server exposes tools covering the full dashboard feature set:

- **Products:** `list_products`, `create_product`, `update_product`, `archive_product`, `list_product_variations`, `bulk_products`
- **Forms:** `upsert_form`, `set_form_theme`, `register_form_fields`, `generate_form`, `publish_form`, `unpublish_form`, `set_form_password`, `get_form_restrictions`, `set_form_restrictions`, `delete_form`, `bulk_forms`
- **Sales:** `list_sales`, `get_sales_summary`, `confirm_sale`, `get_sale_email_status`, `capture_sale`, `release_sale`, `capture_all_pending_sales`
- **Subscriptions:** `list_subscriptions`, `cancel_subscription`, `update_subscription_card`
- **CHIP per-form:** `set_form_chip_override`, `clear_form_chip_override`, `get_form_chip_feeds`, `set_form_chip_feeds`, `get_form_chip_mapping`, `set_form_chip_mapping`
- **e-Invoice:** `set_einvoice`, `get_einvoice_settings`
- **Webhooks:** `create_webhook`, `list_webhooks`, `update_webhook`, `delete_webhook`, `webhook_deliveries`, `retry_webhook_delivery`
- **API keys:** `list_api_keys`, `create_api_key`, `revoke_api_key`
- **Spaces:** `list_spaces`, `create_space`, `get_space_settings`, `set_space_settings`, `get_currency_rates`, `set_space_currency`, `invite_space_member`, `list_space_members`, `update_space_member_role`, `remove_space_member`, `list_space_invites`, `cancel_space_invite`, `set_default_space`
- **Account:** `get_account`, `update_profile_phone`, `update_profile_timezone`
- **Email:** `get_email_settings`, `set_email_settings`, `get_form_email_settings`, `set_form_email_settings`, `get_form_notifications`, `set_form_notifications`, `get_form_confirmations`, `set_form_confirmations`
- **Legal pages:** `generate_legal_page`, `get_legal_page`, `set_legal_page`
- **Events / audit:** `list_events` (account-scoped, read-only), `list_email_deliveries`, `list_form_submissions`, `list_spam_submissions`, `unspam_submission`, `list_spam_sales`, `unspam_sale`
- **Media / templates:** `list_media`, `list_templates`, `use_template`
- **Analytics:** `get_form_analytics`, `get_product_analytics`
- **Custom domains:** `list_domains`, `add_domain`, `verify_domain`, `remove_domain`, `auto_cname_domain`
- **Tracking:** `get_tracking`, `set_tracking`
- **CHIP account settings:** `get_chip_settings`, `set_chip_settings`, `clear_chip_settings`
- **Profile:** `update_profile_avatar`
- **Passkeys:** `list_passkeys`, `delete_passkey`
- **Social accounts:** `list_social_accounts`, `unlink_social_account`
- **2FA:** `get_2fa_status`, `setup_2fa`, `enable_2fa`, `disable_2fa`
- **System settings:** `get_system_settings`, `set_system_setting`
- **Sales export:** `export_sales_csv`
- **Cloudflare:** `get_cloudflare_status`, `connect_cloudflare_api_token`, `connect_cloudflare_global_key`, `disconnect_cloudflare`
- **Webhook signing key:** `get_webhook_signing_key`
- **Admin:** `purge_unverified_accounts`

### Troubleshooting

- Pasting just `mcp.jomform.com` (no scheme/path) fails. You MUST include `https://` and the `/mcp` path.
- If connection fails, ensure your client allows remote MCP servers and HTTP-based OAuth. The server advertises at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.

## 4. Notes for AI agents

- JomForm is a hosted, proprietary service. Public forms on `jomform.com`
  subdomains are not indexed for search (privacy); custom-domain spaces can opt
  into indexing.
- Money values are represented as integer sen (1/100 of a unit) in the API.
- The web dashboard and the MCP server expose the same feature set (feature
  parity is a project rule).
